ranking_plan.future_guard: Freeze scores and budgets before new post-update gold. Compare identical supported candidate pools within each window; never treat continuation repeats or phase subdivisions as independent update windows. Cross-path/window aggregates require later data and implementation.
ranking_plan.primary: Within-window Skill ranking for semantic utility decline; no fitted value regressor is required.
ranking_plan.secondary: Any-change audit uses absolute Delta_M_sem and is reported separately from decline ranking.
ranking_plan.ties: Expected selection under uniform random ordering within ties; never break using gold.
ranking_plan.zero_event_windows: Recall and captured decline mass undefined; report counts, do not silently score as zero.

scope.launch_after: Coverage -> deterministic support freeze -> pre-update ORIGINAL/PLACEBO/NULL baseline only.
scope.stop_after: U35 baseline complete, or no supported Skills; new training windows/paths/storage budget remain to be registered.

source_selection_rule: Latest completed Phase2 checkpoint U35; not selected by Skill utility or prediction performance. New anchors apply only to future windows starting at U35 or later, never retroactively to old held-out tests.
